scope.summary: Implement document color modes as canonical StudioColorProfile-bound states with explicit convert commands and mode-appropriate feature availability: RGB, CMYK, Lab, Grayscale, Bitmap (1-bit with 50%-threshold / pattern-dither / diffusion-dither / halftone-screen / custom-pattern conversion), Indexed Color (palette type, color count, forced colors, transparency, matte, dither, editable color table), Duotone (mono/duo/tri/quadtone ink with per-ink transfer curves and overprint), and Multichannel. No implicit device color — every value carries a StudioColorProfile reference [STU-DOC-003]. Conversions are model-steerable commands subject to STU-RAS-003. Consumes ColorEngine (MT-019).
acceptance_criteria: all 8 color modes convertible with mode-appropriate options
expected_tests: live: convert an RGB document to Grayscale, CMYK, Bitmap (diffusion-dither), and Indexed (with a color count) and confirm each carries a StudioColorProfile
live: Duotone with two inks + transfer curves renders; conversion is promotion-gated
test: no implicit device color present after any conversion

risk_if_missed: No mode conversion; CMYK/prepress, indexed/web, duotone, and bitmap workflows blocked.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
